speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs what is the restraint policy for persons in custody, particularly those who may be vulnerable, such as the elderly.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Persons-in-Custody (PICs) are restrained for a number of reasons.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: One reason is to prevent them from escaping.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Another important reason is to prevent them from causing harm to others or themselves.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The public will not find it acceptable if any of these things happened.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Any indication of unstable or irrational behaviour could also be reasons for coming to such conclusions.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
text: I just wanted to ask a further supplementary question on the restraint policy for those with intellectual disabilities.
